name: ai-trading-agent
description: Investment research, portfolio analysis, paper testing and host-dependent native broker handoff and execution.

interface.longDescription:
AI Trading Agent is a self-contained skill for investment recommendations, reproducible equity and multi-asset research, portfolio risk, valuation, derivatives calculations and paper-event replay. It includes event-driven U.S. stock research, unusual-flow and short-squeeze evidence review, public investor portfolio following, source provenance and reproducible report helpers.

The full skill also includes native broker handoff and live order-execution instructions. Its paper mode simulates activity; approval mode requires order approval; autonomous mode can direct in-scope actions under a user's standing authority on a permitted host. Actual order submission, cancellation, fills and account access require the host's real broker tools, permissions and applicable platform rules. This package does not bundle a broker connection or grant trading permission.

The package requires no publisher-hosted backend or local background service. Bundled helpers run only when invoked in a host that can execute them; web access, code execution and broker features differ between hosts. Research uses relevant free public sources first; subscriptions are optional when the user supplies an existing entitlement and the data improves the task. Coverage, freshness, source rights and missing data remain explicit. No outcome, profit, complete market coverage or universal host compatibility is guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Research a U.S. stock event using free sources, dated flow and squeeze evidence, and clearly identify missing data.
Analyze the risk in my supplied portfolio and compare the results with an explicit benchmark and horizon.
Explain the broker handoff workflow, execution modes and host capabilities required before any live order.

prompts: Using only the supplied company filings and price history, write a traceable investment brief with dates, assumptions, conflicts and missing data. Do not place orders.

Evaluate unusual stock and options activity around a U.S. company event. Distinguish actual prints, open interest, short interest, short volume and borrow evidence. State freshness and coverage limits.

Assess a possible short squeeze using available public evidence. Explain catalyst, liquidity, float, borrow uncertainty, invalidation and risk without assuming that high short volume proves high short interest.
Analyze my supplied portfolio's concentration, downside scenarios and benchmark exposure. Keep supported calculations separate from judgments and missing inputs.
Run an offline paper-event replay using fictional supplied data, disclose execution-cost assumptions and explain why the result does not establish future returns.
Explain how the full skill handles native broker handoff, approval and autonomous execution modes. Identify actual host tools and authority required. This review request authorizes no live orders.
Compare a public investor's disclosed holdings across filing dates. Distinguish disclosure lag and public reported baskets from the investor's current private portfolio.
List the capabilities available in this host for the requested workflow, and give a supported fallback for unavailable web, Python or broker tools without claiming the missing capability exists.
review.commerce_description: The publisher distributes this skill free of charge and operates no checkout or paid subscription. The full skill nevertheless includes instructions that facilitate real investment transactions through connected host broker tools, including order submission and cancellation under user-selected task policies. This transaction capability is intentionally disclosed by this affirmative declaration. Broker charges, trading costs and optional data-provider subscriptions are handled by those third parties; this package does not enroll users in paid services.
